## Purpose

Describe the problem and why this is the smallest suitable change.

## Semantic impact

- [ ] No semantic behavior changes.
- [ ] The change is compatible with the frozen V0.1 contract.
- [ ] New additive semantics are separately specified and versioned.
- [ ] Canonicalization and hash consequences are documented.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the observable behavior and failure cases.
- [ ] `npm run gate:v0.2` passes locally.
- [ ] Determinism was checked across fresh processes when relevant.
- [ ] Proof traces were checked for actual runtime support when relevant.

## Safety

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private datasets, or generated dependency/build
      directories are included.
- [ ] Resource and denial-of-service consequences were considered.
- [ ] Domain-specific behavior remains outside the kernel.
